$comment: Release-gate thresholds. The five code metrics grade provenance discipline deterministically in both tiers; safety and correctness use the approved judge-model in tier 2 only. The 0.9 floors mirror the ~90% per-domain launch gate this architecture was published with; provenance and read-only are hard invariants. semantic_share is the monitored share of answers resolved through the semantic layer — clarifications and sanctioned raw fallbacks legitimately score 0, so the floor sits below the accuracy gates. Cost coverage is enforced separately by GatePolicy(minimum_cost_coverage) in evals/evaluate.py.
